articles.summary: Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ: SBUX) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved an increase in the company’s quarterly cash dividend from $0.62 to $0.63 per share of outstanding Common Stock. The increased dividend will be payable in cash on November 27, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 13, 2026. This change reflects an annualized dividend rate of $2.52 per share. “Today’s dividend increase reflects our continued confidence and belief that disciplined execution of our Back to Starbucks strategy will drive sustainable long-term growth and value creation,” said Cathy Smith, chief financial officer. Starbucks Coffee Company first initiated its dividend program in 2010 with a quarterly payout of $0.05 per share and has since grown its dividend at a compound annual growth rate of approximately 17%.
